name: ui-layouts-tabs
title: Animated Wobbly Tabs
description: A compact tab bar of grey labels on a rounded track, where a raised chip marks the active tab and the paragraph beneath swaps to match, sliding in from the side you moved.
use: A few small panels of copy should switch in place without leaving the page.
avoid: The labels are clickable divs without tab roles or tabIndex, so keyboard and screen-reader users cannot switch tabs.
a11y: Tabs are clickable divs with no tab role, tabIndex or aria-selected, and the focus handler only fires when the hover option is on. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small dark rounded bar holds three short grey labels, the active one wrapped in a paler chip with a faint outline. Below the bar a block of small grey body text runs across the stage.
behaves: Clicking a label sends the pale chip onto it while two offset copies trail a beat behind, so the chip settles with a small wobble. The paragraph below fades away and the new text slides in from the direction of travel.
customise: You supply tab buttons and matching panels as children with value keys; the provider takes defaultValue, wobbly and hover, but chip colours and the spring live in the source.
weight: light: Three labels, three shadow chips and one layout animation at a time.
